fields.name: transmission_bps
docs: Probability that one particle tunnels, in basis points (6500 = 65%).

fields.name: reward_weight
docs: Reward weight of one successful particle.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives protocol fees and swept dust.

fields.name: params
docs: Parameters applied to rounds opened from now on. Open rounds keep their snapshot.

fields.name: reserve_available
docs: $TUNNEL in the reward vault that is not yet committed to any round.

fields.name: initial_emission_per_round
docs: $TUNNEL base units emitted to round 0's epoch.

fields.name: emission_decay_bps
docs: Multiplier applied once per epoch (9990 = emission × 0.999 each epoch).

types.name: RoundVault
docs: Program-owned escrow that holds a round's SOL. Only program instructions
can debit it, and none of them pay out to the admin.

types.name: TreasuryVault
docs: Program-owned, always rent-exempt account that accumulates protocol fees
and swept dust. Fees land here (never directly in an external wallet), so
settlement can never be blocked by the treasury wallet's state.
`withdraw_fees` forwards the balance to the configured treasury.
